gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).

gaps.sentence: To sum ___, we need more time and a bigger budget.
gaps.explanation: sum up = summarize the main points.
